151:     def _vlm_chunk(self, instruction: str):
152:         """One model forward + ``chunk_size`` env steps. Overrides prompt."""
153:         self._check_cancelled()
154:         original_task = self._last_obs.get("task_descriptions")
155:         try:
156:             self._last_obs["task_descriptions"] = instruction
157:             self._last_obs.setdefault("extra_view_images", None)
158: 
159:             actions = self.model.predict(self._last_obs, options={"mode": "eval"})
160:             self._check_cancelled()
161: 
162:             vla_id = (
163:                 self._flywheel.add_proposal(instruction, actions)
164:                 if self._flywheel is not None
165:                 else -1
166:             )
167: 
168:             if not self._recording and self._flywheel is None:
169:                 chunk_obs, _r, _t, _tr, _i = self.env.chunk_step(actions)
170:                 obs = chunk_obs[-1] if self.env.return_all_frames else chunk_obs
171:             else:
172:                 chunk_obs, rewards, terminated, truncated, _info = self.env.chunk_step(
173:                     actions, return_all_frames=True
174:                 )
175:                 for index, obs in enumerate(chunk_obs):
176:                     if self._recording:
177:                         self.record_frame(obs)
178:                     if self._flywheel is not None:
179:                         self._flywheel.add_transition(
180:                             actions[index],
181:                             obs,
182:                             rewards[index],
183:                             terminated[index],

185:                             vla_id=vla_id,
186:                             proposal_index=index,

195:     def pi0_pick(
196:         self,
197:         prompt: str,
198:         *,
199:         max_chunks: int = 24,
200:         lift_thresh: float = 0.05,
201:         gripper_closed_thresh: float = 0.06,
202:         gripper_open_thresh: float = 0.0,
203:         descent_thresh: float = 0.10,
204:     ) -> dict:
205:         """Closed-loop Pi0.5 pick driven by ``prompt`` as the VLA instruction.
206: 
207:         Success requires the EEF to descend by ``descent_thresh``, then rise by
208:         ``lift_thresh``, with gripper opening in
209:         [``gripper_open_thresh``, ``gripper_closed_thresh``). Terminates early
210:         on LIBERO ``terminated`` (official success) or ``max_chunks``.
211:         """
212:         instr = prompt
213:         start_z = self._last_obs_eef_z
214:         peak_z = start_z
215:         min_z = start_z
216:         # Track ascent AFTER min_z has been observed — descent then re-ascent
217:         # is the actual "lift" signal, distinct from raw |peak - min| which
218:         # also fires at the BOTTOM of the descent.
219:         post_min_peak_z = start_z
220:         min_grip = self._last_obs_gripper
221:         last_grip = min_grip
222:         descent_done = False
223:         success = False
224:         chunks_used = 0
225: 
226:         for c in range(max_chunks):
227:             self._vlm_chunk(instr)
228:             chunks_used = c + 1
229:             z = self._last_obs_eef_z
230:             grip = self._last_obs_gripper
231:             peak_z = max(peak_z, z)
232:             if z < min_z:
233:                 min_z = z
234:                 post_min_peak_z = z  # reset after a new deeper min
235:             else:
236:                 post_min_peak_z = max(post_min_peak_z, z)
237:             if (start_z - min_z) >= descent_thresh:
238:                 descent_done = True
239:             min_grip = min(min_grip, grip)
240:             last_grip = grip
241:             ascended = (post_min_peak_z - min_z) >= lift_thresh
242:             closed = gripper_open_thresh <= grip < gripper_closed_thresh
243:             if descent_done and ascended and closed:
244:                 success = True
245:                 break
246:             if self.env.terminated or self.env.truncated:
247:                 success = self.env.terminated
248:                 break
249: 
250:         return {
251:             "name": "pick",
252:             "instruction": instr,
253:             "success": success,
254:             "chunks_used": chunks_used,
255:             "max_chunks": max_chunks,
256:             "peak_lift_m": post_min_peak_z - min_z,  # actual post-descent ascent
257:             "min_gripper_opening": min_grip,
258:             "final_gripper_opening": last_grip,
259:             "terminated": self.env.terminated,
260:             "truncated": self.env.truncated,
261:             "diagnostics": {
262:                 "start_eef_z": round(start_z, 4),
263:                 "peak_eef_z": round(peak_z, 4),
264:                 "min_eef_z": round(min_z, 4),
265:                 "post_min_peak_z": round(post_min_peak_z, 4),
266:                 "descent_m": round(start_z - min_z, 4),
267:                 "post_min_ascent_m": round(post_min_peak_z - min_z, 4),
268:                 "descent_done": descent_done,
269:                 "lift_thresh": lift_thresh,
270:                 "gripper_closed_thresh": gripper_closed_thresh,
271:                 "gripper_open_thresh": gripper_open_thresh,
272:                 "descent_thresh": descent_thresh,
273:             },
274:         }

22:     def tokenize(self, prompt: str, state: np.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
23:         cleaned_text = prompt.strip().replace("_", " ").replace("\n", " ")
24:         if state is not None:
25:             # This is the Pi05 format, where the state is part of the discrete language input.
26:             discretized_state = np.digitize(state, bins=np.linspace(-1, 1, 256 + 1)[:-1]) - 1
27:             state_str = " ".join(map(str, discretized_state))
28:             full_prompt = f"Task: {cleaned_text}, State: {state_str};\nAction: "
29:             tokens = self._tokenizer.encode(full_prompt, add_bos=True)
30:         else:
31:             # This is the Pi0 format, where the state is part of the continuous action expert input.
32:             # tokenize "\n" separately as the "start of answer" token
33:             tokens = self._tokenizer.encode(cleaned_text, add_bos=True) + self._tokenizer.encode("\n")
34:         tokens_len = len(tokens)
35:         if tokens_len < self._max_len:
36:             padding = [False] * (self._max_len - tokens_len)
37:             mask = [True] * tokens_len + padding
38:             tokens = tokens + padding
39:         else:
40:             if len(tokens) > self._max_len:
41:                 logging.warning(
